name: Elize von Ronzberg
original_name: エリーゼ・フォン・ロンズベルク
source:
Daughter of the lord. She spends most of the time at home because her body is weak. She is a dreaming maiden who likes reading.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
